status_rule: After completing a task, set its check field to true. In future runs, only tasks with check false are eligible for work.
scope: Improve selection preset management, add pinned preset shortcuts on the home screen, and align selected card/export button styling.
assumptions: Pinned presets are still stored per algset under the existing selectionPresets.<datasetKey> localStorage key.
Pinned presets appear on the home screen under the section title "프리셋 바로가기".
Clicking a preset shortcut loads its algset, applies that preset, turns on selected-only, and enters the note screen.
Pinned state defaults to false for existing presets.
The home export button should use the same white-background general button style as ordinary action buttons.

tasks.title: Align selected card and export styles
tasks.summary: Make selected cards use the current accent theme and make the home 수정 JSON button look like a normal white action button.
verify: Selected card active styles use var(--accent) and var(--accent-soft).
The home 수정 JSON button no longer uses accent fill styling.
Bookmark and recognition colors remain unchanged.

tasks.title: Add pinned field to presets
tasks.summary: Extend preset objects with pinned: boolean, defaulting to false for existing and newly saved presets unless toggled.
verify: Existing presets without pinned load successfully as pinned false.
Saving migrated presets preserves id, name, and selectedCards.
New presets include pinned false.

tasks.title: Redesign sidebar preset rows
tasks.summary: Render presets as file-list style rows with a document affordance, name, case count, pin control, and delete control.
verify: Preset rows visually differ from plain general action buttons.
Clicking the row/apply area still applies the preset.
Delete remains a small separate control.

tasks.title: Add preset pin toggle
tasks.summary: Add a pin-shaped toggle per preset; pinned presets are saved, styled, and listed above unpinned presets.
verify: Pin button toggles pinned true/false without applying the preset.
Pinned state persists after refresh.
Pinned rows sort above unpinned rows while keeping relative order inside each group.

tasks.title: Render home preset shortcuts
tasks.summary: Add a home section titled "프리셋 바로가기" that lists pinned presets gathered from all algsets.
verify: Section title is exactly "프리셋 바로가기".
The section is hidden or empty-state-free when no presets are pinned.
Shortcut cards show algset context, preset name, and selected case count.

tasks.title: Apply preset shortcut from home
tasks.summary: Clicking a home shortcut loads the matching algset, applies the preset, enables selected-only, and opens the note screen.
verify: Clicking a shortcut opens the correct algset.
The shortcut preset becomes active.
Selected-only is on and selectedCards match the preset.

tasks.title: Refresh and validate preset shortcuts
tasks.summary: Ensure preset shortcut UI updates after preset saves, deletes, and pin toggles, then validate the implementation.
verify: Run node --check app/js/app.js.
Confirm pinning/unpinning updates the home shortcut section.
Confirm deleting a pinned preset removes its shortcut.
Confirm existing filter, view, selection, and drill entry behavior still works.
